title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 4: Don't Give Up

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa whose glimmer is the golden dragon Kyodai; she finds Nashi and nearly dies in a fateshifter vision.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Theros who traps glitch ghosts in shards and hits every target.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A survivor who came through a door with his best friend years ago and guides Niko and the Wanderer.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A child nezumi Reckoner who is rescued from a wickerfolk cage and is determined to find his mother in the House.

entities.name: Kyodai's Glimmer
entities.description: A golden dragon of light that is the Wanderer's glimmer and guides the party through the House.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights a nightmare with Jace, is abandoned in a gel pit and planeswalks back to Ravnica.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: Kaito's mechanical-spirit companion that picks Jace's shackle locks.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage who dissolves a nightmare, searches for Vraska and abandons Kaito in a pit.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon Jace has been traveling with; a vision shows her shielding a creature from blade-made monsters.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Quandrix student carrying books who survives with Tyvar by hiding as part of the House and sees a vision of her own transformation.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince who uses stone and plaster camouflage to hide himself and Zimone from the House.

entities.name: Phantom Dean Kianne
entities.description: A translucent image of Dean Kianne made of the House that tries to lure Zimone and attacks Tyvar.

entities.name: Dean Kianne
entities.description: The Quandrix dean who was compleated by Phyrexia and died.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: The fate-magic girl who gave the team fateshifters.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: A figure of Kaldheim whose ribbons make rainbows in frozen mist.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A vast creature Tyvar compares the House to.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description: Rat-like people held captive in wicker cages, including Nashi.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Spindly wicker-and-stick creatures that dance around a cold fire and transform captives into woven dolls.

entities.name: Glitch ghosts
entities.description: Shuddering, refracting entities that enter the House through reflective surfaces.

entities.name: Nightmare
entities.description: A tentacled gelatinous being with ghostly heads in its mouth that Jace dissolves by removing the dreamers' fear.

entities.name: Fateshifters
entities.description: Tokens of Aminatou's power that roll back a deadly choice for the holder.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The hungry house-plane that sets lures and shifts its rooms.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invader whose compleation and invasion marked Zimone and the others.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Where Kaito and Jace fought.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Kaito planeswalks back to.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: Zimone's campus, devastated by the invasion.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: Zimone's college and Kianne's.

events.summary: The glimmer of Kyodai leads Winter, Niko and the Wanderer through the House, ignored by its horrors.
events.quote: The gleaming golden shadow of Kyodai led them onward

events.summary: Winter explains that glitch ghosts enter the House through reflective surfaces.
events.quote: They use reflective surfaces to enter the House.

events.summary: A glitch ghost drags itself from a mirror toward Niko.
events.quote: a shuddering entity began to drag itself from the mirror frame

events.summary: Niko traps the glitch ghost inside a magical shard, which Winter had thought impossible.
events.quote: The shard hit the entity, and the entity was gone, while the shard remained

events.summary: Winter is stunned that Niko can defeat a ghost without a ghost-catcher.
events.quote: What you just did isn't possible!

events.summary: Winter tells the Wanderer that the House has taken the whole outside, leaving everything inside.
events.quote: There's no outside left.

events.summary: The group discovers a clearing where wickerfolk dance around a cold fire next to cages of nezumi captives.
events.quote: There were seven in all, four of them occupied by humanoid rats

events.summary: The Wanderer sees Nashi, the smallest captive, silently watching the wickerfolk.
events.quote: eyes fixed on the smallest of the rat-people, who sat at the bottom of his cage, arms around his knees

events.summary: A wickerfolk plants bamboo in a captive nezumi, turning it into a woven doll that joins the dance.
events.quote: The rat-person was gone, leaving a woven wicker doll behind, lifeless and limp.

events.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the Wanderer charges, cuts open Nashi's cage and is killed by branches bursting from her ribs.
events.quote: Blood began to blossom on the front of her tabard before tree branches burst out of her ribcage

events.summary: The vision shatters as the Wanderer clutches Aminatou's fateshifter, having narrowly averted the choice.
events.quote: the vision shattered as the Wanderer gasped, hand going to the pocket where she had tucked Aminatou's fateshifter

events.summary: Niko throws a ghost-filled shard at the lead wickerfolk and another that encloses Nashi and carries him out of the cage.
events.quote: The second struck Nashi, enveloping him as it flew onward, through the bars of the cage.

events.summary: The Wanderer frees the other captive nezumi, who say wickerfolk fear fire.
events.quote: The Wanderer dodged them easily, moving to cut the other occupied cages open.

events.summary: The Wanderer uses Winter's lighter to ignite grass and drive the wickerfolk into the woods.
events.quote: A tiny flame shot out, and the grass lit up, burning like a beacon.

events.summary: Niko releases Nashi from the shard and the Wanderer embraces him; he pulls away.
events.quote: Nashi was suddenly standing there, looking perplexed for only a moment before the Wanderer pulled him into an embrace.

events.summary: Nashi asks for help to find his mother after losing most of his crew.
events.quote: I've been searching for my mother since I got here

events.summary: A tentacled nightmare crawls from the basement wall toward Jace and Kaito.
events.quote: some terrible, shapeless, tentacled thing began to crawl out and into the room where they both stood.

events.summary: Jace reads the nightmare's mind and says it is a nightmare given substance.
events.quote: This is a nightmare given substance.

events.summary: Kaito deflects its tentacle with a wall of floor debris.
events.quote: the little flecks of stone that littered the floor rose up in a wall of debris that blocked the strike

events.summary: Jace dissolves the nightmare by taking away the dreamers' fear.
events.quote: I reached into the dreamers I felt inside it and took their fears away.

events.summary: Jace apologizes for vanishing after the invasion and says he is searching for Vraska.
events.quote: I've been traveling with Vraska and our new companion.

events.summary: The creature stops pursuing Tyvar and Zimone, and they rest.
events.quote: The creature wasn't following them anymore.

events.summary: A translucent image of Dean Kianne emerges from the wall and tries to draw Zimone to her.
events.quote: what pulled itself free was not the spindly, terrible attacker, but an elegant elf woman

events.summary: The phantom claims she let Phyrexia take her to prove her theories on mana transformation.
events.quote: I let them take me, darling.

events.summary: Tyvar holds Zimone back and calls the phantom a trick.
events.quote: Why would she be trying to convince you to come to her?

events.summary: In a fateshifter vision, the creature's claw rips Tyvar open through the phantom's chest.
events.quote: slicing through skin and muscle with ease

events.summary: The vision breaks and Tyvar, clutching his fateshifter, realizes he must stand and fight.
events.quote: the moment shattered like the ice at a river's edge on a winter morning, leaving Tyvar gasping, one hand going to the fateshifter he had tucked into his belt

events.summary: Tyvar grabs the creature's wrist and turns his own body to plaster, matching its flesh.
events.quote: what looked like plaster began to crawl up his hands, engulfing his arms.

events.summary: Tyvar explains the camouflage makes them part of the House so its defenses ignore them.
events.quote: Until I release the magic, we are made of the House, and the House doesn't see us as invaders.

events.summary: Zimone and Tyvar find a room of carved doors and realize the House is setting lures in other places.
events.quote: it's setting lures in places where it might be able to attract more people.

events.summary: Tyvar begins to sound like the House, speaking of devouring the Multiverse, and Zimone's vision shows her becoming a small version of the creature.
events.quote: body breaking from the inside as it blossomed into a new, smaller version of the creature from before

events.summary: Zimone's fateshifter pulls her back and she begs Tyvar to release the camouflage.
events.quote: her fateshifter a burning coal against her skin

events.summary: The plaster bleeds from their skin and Tyvar apologizes.
events.quote: The plaster bled out of their skins until they were themselves again.

events.summary: Tyvar finds a tattered vest to help them look like part of the House.
events.quote: Tyvar rummaged around the nearest set of shelves, pulling out a tattered vest.

events.summary: Winter reveals he came through a door years ago with his best friend, who is now gone.
events.quote: My best friend and I, we walked through one of those doors years ago.

events.summary: Nashi refuses to talk to the Wanderer, saying the House took his mother and he will not leave her.
events.quote: This house took my mother. We're going to get her back.

events.summary: Jace and Kaito fall into a pit of stinging gel.
events.quote: the floor gave way beneath their feet and they fell, not into nothingness, but into a pit filled with some thick, gelatinous substance

events.summary: Manacles clasp Kaito's ankles as he touches a rung.
events.quote: shouted as he felt manacles clasp around his ankles.

events.summary: Himoto picks the locks on Jace's shackles.
events.quote: Himoto began working at the locks on Jace's shackles, manipulating the tumblers until they clicked open.

events.summary: A projection on the ceiling shows Vraska shielding a small creature from blade-bodied monsters.
events.quote: There, projected on the ceiling, was Vraska, shielding a small, orange-furred creature with her body

events.summary: Jace abandons Kaito in the pit, climbing the rungs and triggering the manacles that pull Kaito down.
events.quote: Before Kaito realized what was happening, Jace began to climb.

events.summary: Drowning in gel, Kaito planeswalks back to Ravnica.
events.quote: and planeswalked away, back to Ravnica, back to the beginning, where he might yet survive.

relations.note: Latches onto him in the pit.
relations.quote: He felt Himoto latch onto his leg.

relations.note: Niko offers to take Winter out of the House.
Traveling companions whom he searches for.
relations.quote: I've been traveling with Vraska and our new companion.
You've been absent from my classes for weeks
through the translucent chest of the Quandrix dean

relations.note: An image of her made of the House, not the real person.
relations.quote: So is the image of your lost friend.

relations.note: She rescues him but he refuses to listen to her.

relations.quote: hiding behind Tyvar, who stood his ground
